label: B17

T06.evidence: With the 10-day trip at 1280 the board scrolls inside itself (overflow-x: auto on .days, scrollWidth 2992 in 852), but the page scrollWidth is 2879, so the page scrolls too. At 375 the 4-day trip makes the page scroll 688 px. Cause: the absolutely positioned sr-only 'to day N' spans in each Add button use <body> as their offsetParent and escape the board's clip.

T30.evidence: Bad imports show no error. Non-JSON and {"foo":1} files leave the data unchanged, but nothing tells the user. showImportError() calls setError('importError'), which writes into '#importError-err', and that element does not exist. #importError and #importErrorEmpty stay empty, and no toast or banner appears (checked directly after the run).

G07.evidence: 1280: the search field's magnifier icon (absolute, x 44-62) sits on top of the placeholder/typed text, which starts at x 44 (padding-left 12px). The 'S' of 'Search by title or place' is covered.

G08.evidence: 375: the page scrolls 688 px sideways (scrollWidth 1063; same sr-only cause as T06), and the search icon also overlaps the text (same cause as G07). Both causes are counted elsewhere.

note: The other 29 trip items pass. T18: the cost reopens as "12.5" for 12.50, which is the same value. Search-icon overlap was checked on all builds that have a search field; only B17 overlaps.
